applicableAreas: Site Plan Release Notes on Sheet 9
findings.comment: Condominium-specific requirement note (Chapter 81/82 Property Code compliance) is present on Sheet 9, Block 5, item (g). Applicability cannot be verified without confirmation of the project's actual legal structure (whether it will be filed as a condominium or as multi-family rental). The applicant's intent and housing/condominium documentation must be reviewed to determine if this note is appropriately applicable.

applicableAreas: Fire Zone Notes on Fire Protection Plan
findings.comment: Fire Zone Notes, Item 1 references 'lockers and boat slip retaining walls' which are not applicable to this residential townhomes development. This boilerplate language must be removed or replaced with site-specific requirements. The note currently reads: 'Restricted Zone signage to be placed on front of lockers and along boat slip retaining walls as necessary or required.'

Recycling ordinance note (Block 11, Sheet 1) references the outdated 'Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance.' Per current City of Austin standards, this must be updated to reference the 'Universal Recycling Ordinance' to reflect the current regulatory language.

applicableAreas: Fire Department requirements table on cover sheet
findings.comment: Austin Fire Department requirements table (Block 5, Sheet 1) cites the '2021 International Fire Code Edition.' This must be updated to the 2024 International Fire Code to reflect the current adopted edition per City of Austin local amendments.

applicableAreas: Site Plan Release Notes on Sheet 9
findings.comment: Site Plan Release Notes, item (e) contains bracketed instructional template text that has not been replaced with project-specific information: '[or identify the service provider if other than the City of Austin].' This placeholder text must be removed and replaced with the actual utility service provider name (City of Austin Water and Wastewater Utility).

Integrated Pest Management Plan note (Block 12, Sheet 1) contains a blank placeholder for the recorded document number: 'document No.____________'. This placeholder must be replaced with the actual recorded document number once the IPM Plan agreement is filed in the Official Public Records of Travis County, Texas.
